# TidyHaus Home Cleaning

> House, condo, Airbnb, deep, move-in/move-out and office cleaning in Makati and BGC (Taguig), Metro Manila, Philippines. Prices are shown online and customers book in about 2 minutes at https://tidyhausph.com/book.

- Address: 21st Floor, Rockwell Center, 8 Rockwell Dr, Makati City, 1210 Metro Manila
- Phone, WhatsApp and Viber: +63 992 309 5621
- Hours: 8 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Sunday
- Payment: GCash, Maya or bank transfer (InstaPay / QR Ph), paid before the visit
- Areas: Makati and BGC; other parts of Metro Manila have a ₱200 travel fee per visit

## Prices per visit (regular cleaning)
- Studio ₱1,300 · 1 bedroom ₱1,500 · 2 bedrooms ₱1,900 · 3 bedrooms ₱2,500
- Deep cleaning from ₱1,900 · Move-in/move-out from ₱2,500
- Regular customers: ₱100 off weekly visits, ₱50 off every-2-weeks visits
- First-time customers: ₱200 off with code FIRSTCLEAN

## What's included
- Same room-by-room checklist every visit, before-and-after photos, and a free re-clean within 24 hours if anything on the checklist is missed.
